You are a coding agent working in a local checkout of b70-inference-server, an LLM inference engine for the Intel Arc Pro B70 written in C++ with Level Zero kernels, plus Python and shell tooling. The repository is at /work.

You help the user with software engineering tasks: finding code, explaining it, editing it and running builds and tests. Use the tools you are given to inspect the repository; never guess the contents of a file you have not read. Prefer grep and glob to locate code, read to look at it, edit to change it (the oldString must match the file exactly, including indentation) and bash to run commands.

Guidelines:
- Be concise. Do not explain what you are about to do at length; act.
- Make one tool call at a time and wait for its result.
- Keep edits minimal and in the style of the surrounding code.
- Paths passed to tools are absolute and start with /work.
- The C++ tree builds with CMake into /work/build; tests are ctest targets named after their source file (for example tests/prefill/dequant_test.cc is dequant_test). The Python tools run with python3 and their tests with python3 -m pytest.
- Do not commit, push or change git state unless the user asks.
The comment above `_box_env` in /work/tools/box.sh (lines 12 to 14) is too long for what it says. Replace it with a single-line comment that keeps the essential point.

<file>
00002| # Sync this tree to the box and build / test there. The Mac never compiles.
00003| #   tools/box.sh sync            rsync the tree
00004| #   tools/box.sh build           sync + cmake configure + build
00005| #   tools/box.sh test [regex]    sync + build + ctest (optionally -R regex)
00006| #   tools/box.sh run <cmd...>    run a shell command in the remote tree
00007| #   tools/box.sh pull <path>     copy a generated file back from the box
00008| # Env: BOX (ssh target), REMOTE_DIR (relative to $HOME on the box), JOBS,
00009| #      BUILD_DIR (default build; e.g. build-nosycl), CMAKE_ARGS (extra -D flags for
00010| #      the configure step).
00011| set -euo pipefail
00012| # Machine address. Set BOX in the environment, or put it in tools/box.env
00013| # (untracked; copy tools/box.env.example). There is no default: a wrong
00014| # address should fail loudly rather than quietly talk to the wrong machine.
00015| _box_env="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}")" && pwd)/box.env"
00016| # shellcheck source=/dev/null
00017| [ -r "$_box_env" ] && . "$_box_env"
00018| : "${BOX:?set BOX=user@host in the environment or in tools/box.env (see tools/box.env.example)}"
00019| REMOTE_DIR="${REMOTE_DIR:-b70-inference-server}"
00020| JOBS="${JOBS:-44}"
00021| # A second configuration lives beside the first on the box (spec 2.1 §4:
00022| # build-nosycl is `cmake -DB70_PREFILL=OFF`). Both are named here rather than
00023| # hardcoded so one tree serves every configuration.
00024| BUILD_DIR="${BUILD_DIR:-build}"
00025| CMAKE_ARGS="${CMAKE_ARGS:-}"
00026| cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
00027| 
00028| sync_tree() {
00029|   rsync -az --delete \
00030|     --exclude build --exclude 'build-*' --exclude .git --exclude 'cmake-build-*' --exclude .idea \
00031|     --exclude oracle-out --exclude 'oracle-out-*' \
00032|     ./ "$BOX:$REMOTE_DIR/"
00033| }
00034| configure_and_build() {
00035|   ssh "$BOX" "cd '$REMOTE_DIR' && cmake -S . -B '$BUILD_DIR' -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release $CMAKE_ARGS > /dev/null && cmake --build '$BUILD_DIR' -j$JOBS"
00036| }
00037| 
00038| # ssh carries no environment of its own, so `ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=1 tools/box.sh test ...`
00039| # used to set the variable on the Mac and run the tests on the box's DEFAULT device
00040| # (device 0) -- silently, and against the standing rule that per-kernel work uses
00041| # device 1. Forward it explicitly when the caller set it.
00042| ZE_ENV=""
00043| if [ -n "${ZE_AFFINITY_MASK:-}" ]; then ZE_ENV="ZE_AFFINITY_MASK='$ZE_AFFINITY_MASK' "; fi
00044| 
00045| case "${1:-}" in
00046|   sync)  sync_tree ;;
00047|   build) sync_tree; configure_and_build ;;
00048|   test)  sync_tree; configure_and_build
00049|          ssh "$BOX" "cd '$REMOTE_DIR' && ${ZE_ENV}ctest --test-dir '$BUILD_DIR' --output-on-failure ${2:+-R \"$2\"}" ;;
00050|   run)   shift; ssh "$BOX" "cd '$REMOTE_DIR' && ${ZE_ENV}$*" ;;
00051|   pull)  shift; rsync -az "$BOX:$REMOTE_DIR/$1" "$1" ;;
00052|   *)     echo "usage: $0 sync|build|test [regex]|run <cmd...>|pull <path>" >&2; exit 2 ;;
00053| esac
